scripts.cap:sync: next build && npx cap sync android
scripts.build:apk: npm run cap:sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleRelease && cp app/build/outputs/apk/release/app-release.apk ../release-builds/ShriKalyan.apk
scripts.build:aab: npm run cap:sync && cd android && ./gradlew bundleRelease && cp app/build/outputs/bundle/release/app-release.aab ../release-builds/ShriKalyan.aab
